description: Parcel boundaries joined to assessor/tax-roll attributes (owner, acreage, market value, year built, building sqft, primary-residence flag, property class) via the statewide Land Information Records (LIR) schema. The authoritative growth/housing base layer for Juab.
notes: ~15,259 parcels. Land value, built year, unit counts per parcel — the base for any Juab growth/housing question. Do NOT bulk-download; query by bbox/where.

description: Parcel boundary polygons only (no tax-roll attributes).
notes: ~15,258 polygons. Use the LIR variant unless you only need geometry.

description: County boundary polygons statewide (includes Juab County / FIPS 49023).
notes: 29 counties; filter NAME='JUAB' (FIPS 49023). County extent for clipping/joins.

description: Incorporated city/town boundaries statewide (Nephi, Mona, Levan, Eureka, Rocky Ridge in Juab), COGO-derived, annexation-maintained.
notes: 261 municipalities statewide; filter to Juab by county field / bbox. The which-land-is-in-which-jurisdiction frame — the Juab jurisdictions that appear in the elections layer.

description: Point locations for every USPS-assigned address in Utah; the state's authoritative geocoding base.
notes: ~1.49M statewide; filter to Juab by CountyID=12 / county field. Backs address->jurisdiction lookups.

description: Best-effort inventory of housing units per parcel/development (SF, ADU, townhome, condo, apartment, mobile-home park, PUD) from parcel/LIR/assessor data.
notes: ~696k units statewide incl. Juab. Housing supply/type/density questions. Filter to Juab by county/bbox.

description: 2020 Census tract polygons (the standard demographic-join geography).
notes: Demographic join geography for Juab housing/growth analysis; filter by county FIPS 49023.
